title: Ordered completed exchange equals the completion-unit-conjugated ordinary mate
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite normed field extension, put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and fix a uniformizer $\varpi$. Let $k$ have positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$, and let all schemes mentioned be separated and of finite type over $k$. Require explicitly that each scheme is Noetherian and finite dimensional and that $\ell$ is invertible in its local rings. On the small pro-etale site put $A_T=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise operations. Use the integral category $\mathcal I_T=\Dbc(T,A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and its raw scalar localization $\mathcal R_T=\mathcal I_T[1/\varpi]$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $\square=(f,f',g,g')$ be a cartesian square of these schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$ proper, and let $K\in\mathcal I_X$, retaining any choice of its compatible etale-origin witnesses. Put $M=Lg_A^*Rf_{*,A}K$ and $N=Rf'_{*,A}Lg_A'^*K$, using ordinary ambient operations, and let $e:M\to N$ be their unit-square-counit mate [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. Let $\gamma_g:M\to Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_{*,A}K$ and $\gamma_{g'}:Lg_A'^*K\to Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$ be the specified completion units of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. They are isomorphisms and the ordered completed exchange of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map] satisfies the equality
$$\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp}}_{\square,K}=(Rf'_{*,A}\gamma_{g'})\,e\,\gamma_g^{-1}.$$
This is equality for the specified strict-tower map and its actual endpoint comparisons, with no assertion that $e$ or exchange is invertible.

proof.text: The coefficient prime lies in the uniformizer ideal: its extended p-adic norm is strictly below one, and the chosen DVR maximal ideal is generated by the chosen uniformizer. Stalkwise invertibility gives invertibility in global sections. Properness is stable under the chosen Cartesian base change. The finite-type fibre dimension bound, residue-field factorization of a field-valued point, pullback pasting, and invariance of finite-type dimension under field extension give one geometric fibre bound. Apply actual-coefficient constructible preservation to obtain Rf_*K in the same actual-valuation-ring integral category.

source.place: Propositions 6.6.11 and 6.8.14(2), Remark 6.8.15; actual-model transport and categorical cancellation written by F6

proof.text: For either ordinary pullback (g,Rf_*K) or (g-prime,K), apply the actual-valuation-ring local perfect criterion to the input. Pull back its finite locally closed stratification, retaining empty strata. Pull back each covering sieve along the cover-preserving pro-etale base-change functor and the canonical terminal-object isomorphism. Every new chart factors through a base-changed old chart. Ordinary derived composition, its datum/actual transport, and the constant-model pullback isomorphism carry the old bounded finite-projective complex to the same scalar complex on the new chart. Apply the local perfect criterion backwards. Thus both ordinary pullbacks belong to the bounded constructible complete category.

proof.text: Intrinsic completeness implies quotient-tower completeness for each ordinary pullback and each input. The first equation of completed-target-augmentation-normalization says that the specified ordinary-to-completed unit followed by the derived-limit image of the reduction/pullback isomorphism equals the ordinary pullback completion unit. The latter and the second factor are invertible, so both specified units are invertible.

source.place: Propositions 6.6.11 and 6.8.14(2), Remark 6.8.15; actual-model transport and categorical cancellation written by F6

proof.text: Take asIso of these actual units; their homs are definitionally the prescribed maps. The already proved completed-exchange-unit equation identifies source-unit followed by completed exchange with ordinary exchange followed by pushforward of the other unit. Cancel the source unit and simplify its inverse. This proves the displayed conjugation formula without inverting either exchange.
